description: This file contains unit tests for POSIX thread synchronization primitives, specifically testing pthread_once functionality, including single initialization, multiple initializations, multi-threaded initialization, and singleton pattern implementation.

classes.name: RunPosixOnceContext
classes.description: Context structure holding synchronization primitives and control for testing pthread_once in multi-threaded scenarios.

methods.name: IncrementGlobalValue
methods.description: Function that increments the global counter, used as the init routine for pthread_once.

methods.name: RunPosixOnceEntryPoint
methods.description: Thread entry point that calls pthread_once multiple times, used to test thread-safe initialization.

methods.name: GetIntSingleton
methods.description: Function that returns a singleton integer pointer, initialized once via pthread_once.
